headline: Saudi Forces Report Seven Houthi Weapons Intercepted
deck: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed three ballistic missiles aimed at the Eastern Province and four drones headed south.
body: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three Houthi ballistic missiles launched toward Saudi Arabia and four drones headed toward the kingdom’s southern region. Reuters reported that the missiles were headed for the Eastern Region; SANA separately reported the coalition’s account. [E1][E2][E3][E4]
The reported interceptions are a new development since the paper reported on Oct. 25 that King Khalid International Airport had reopened terminals 1 and 2 for domestic and international flights. [E5]

File photo: SPA Riyadh, Oct. 27 (SANA) The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said Tuesday that its forces had intercepted and destroyed four drones and three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward Saudi Arabia . Coalition spokesperson Brig. Gen. Turki al-Maliki said in a statement posted on X that four drones launched toward the kingdom’s southern region had been intercepted and destroyed.
